findings.detail: en 'Waiting on you? lop sessions shows what a run needs' -> es '¿Algo te espera? lop sessions muestra lo que necesita una ejecución'. The subject flips: English says the run is waiting on the reader, Spanish says something awaits the reader. It lands on the same behaviour (a supervised run parked on a gate) and is printed to stderr, so no width budget is involved; the wording is merely less pointed than the English.
findings.remediation: '¿Te está esperando? lop sessions muestra lo que necesita una ejecución' (70 cells).

findings.detail: The same --tools promise is phrased two ways in one namespace: 'limita el alcance de esta ejecución a esas herramientas' (approval_advisory) and 'limita a qué puede llegar la ejecución' (exec_epilog). The second is a calque of 'bounds what the run can reach' and reads as translated; both keep the promise (excluded tools are unreachable), so this is style.
findings.remediation: Use 'limita el alcance de la ejecución a esas herramientas' in both.
